name: federated-loopback
description: Two-workspace federation you can run on ONE server, zero tokens: the a2a phase calls this same workspace's smoke-test orchestration over real A2A (card fetch → JSON-RPC message/send → task polling → a durable run on the receiving side). Point ${peer} at another sammy-pack server to make it genuinely two-workspace. The idempotencyKey makes the dispatch safe to re-send after a crash — the receiver returns the existing task instead of starting a duplicate run.

phases.name: compose-brief
phases.description: Deterministic prep — shape the input the remote agent will receive.

code.source: return 'federation brief: ' + (input || 'hello from the caller workspace')

phases.name: remote-run
phases.description: Real A2A dispatch: fetches the peer's agent card, submits the brief as a task, polls to completion, folds the artifact in.

phases.name: wrap-up
phases.description: Local synthesis of the remote result.
